verdicts.reason: A is cramped. 'WEEKEND ONLY' and the oversized Shop Sale button nearly touch the top and bottom edges, and the body copy is set so large that it competes with the '20% off' headline. B has calmer margins and a clear headline > body > CTA order, with a well-proportioned button. Its flaws are a wide, uneven gap between the headline and the body copy, a product circle that almost touches the canvas edges, and legal text in both candidates that is far too small to read.
